title: Ghostly Cat’s Head Nebula Lurks Within Sight of NASA’s Hubble, Webb
caption:
NASA telescopes have captured the 'Cat's Head Nebula' within the Carina region. By combining Hubble and Webb imagery, we can see the young star hiding inside this temporary cosmic sculpture.

Source: Science - Ghostly Cat’s Head Nebula Lurks Within Sight of NASA’s Hubble, Webb

https://science.nasa.gov/missions/hubble/ghostly-cats-head-nebula-lurks-within-sight-of-nasas-hubble-webb/
